phase-plan.purpose: Re-open phase 58 and review the proposed terminology and model with the user. The goal is to replace any invented vocabulary that does not match the intended concepts for DungeonBreak, Escape the Dungeon, room reuse, level reuse, and Unreal level/content workflows.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: concept teaching, terminology review, world-model boundaries, reuse boundaries, and corrections to prior phase-58 assumptions. Out of scope: implementation work or code changes beyond planning-doc corrections.
phase-plan.definition-of-done: Done when the user has reviewed and either approved or replaced the proposed nouns and model boundaries, and the phase-58 docs are updated to match that agreed language.

task.description: Teach back the currently proposed model in plain language and show where it diverges from the user's expectations.
Capture the user's preferred nouns and concept boundaries for regions, towns, wilderness, outskirts, floors, levels, rooms, and Unreal workflows.
Revise the phase-58 plans and decisions to match the approved terminology before any execution work starts.

questions.question: A level is the shared loadable concept. The docs now capture region-level and floor-like progression as the primary current kinds, with room structure and richer kind variants to be refined later during execution.
Rooms are a real authored concept inside levels. Region-levels may contain non-room structures as well, but room-aware dungeon content remains first-class.
The agreed Unreal workflow is hybrid: browser plus drag-drop first, with managed deterministic placement/update added later where it is useful.

decision.summary: Phase 58 was reopened because the previously proposed neutral vocabulary was inferred too aggressively. The revised direction is now level-centered, uses the user's nouns directly, and is now locked for future work.
decision.impact: Future implementation work should follow the level-centered model and hybrid Unreal workflow captured in the revised docs.

suggestion.gap: REQUIREMENTS.xml does not currently state that phase-58 execution must follow the user's approved level-centered world model and Unreal workflow assumptions.
suggestion.proposal: Add a requirement that level is the shared loadable concept, rooms remain first-class authored concepts, and Unreal integration may begin as a per-level content browser/drag-drop workflow before full auto-placement.
